mapper.sql: id, student_id, resume_object_key, resume_file_name, resume_text_snapshot, profile_json, profile_status, profile_error_message, profile_generated_at, voice_session_id, status, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: insert into mock_interview_session ( student_id, resume_object_key, resume_file_name, resume_text_snapshot, profile_status, status, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{studentId}, #{resumeObjectKey}, #{resumeFileName}, #{resumeTextSnapshot}, #{profileStatus}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: select from mock_interview_session where student_id = #{studentId} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update mock_interview_session set profile_status = 'PROFILE_SUCCESS', profile_json = #{profileJson}, profile_error_message = null, profile_generated_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id}
